{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /root/phase-gated-compound-sparse/env.sh
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1

GPU_ID=${1:-1}
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPU_ID

echo "===== PHASE 2: 3-Method Self-Iterate Comparison ====="
echo "GPU: $GPU_ID"
echo "Start: $(date)"

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

COMMON_ARGS="--student_model gpt2 \
    --self_iterate \
    --data_dir /root/phase-gated-compound-sparse/data_gpt2 \
    --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/phase-gated-compound-sparse/results_phase2 \
    --num_generations 8 \
    --gen_tokens 500000 \
    --train_epochs 3 \
    --train_lr 5e-5 \
    --train_batch_size 4 \
    --train_grad_accum 8 \
    --seq_len 512 \
    --gpu_ids 0 \
    --seed 42 \
    --no_quality_filter"

echo ""
echo "===== [1/3] UNCURATED ====="
echo "Start uncurated: $(date)"
python3 /root/phase-gated-compound-sparse/run_mvp.py \
    --method uncurated $COMMON_ARGS
echo "Done uncurated: $(date)"

echo ""

echo "Start rgds: $(date)"

    --method rgds $COMMON_ARGS
echo "Done rgds: $(date)"

echo ""
echo "===== [3/3] EXTERNAL_ONLY ====="
echo "Start external_only: $(date)"
python3 /root/phase-gated-compound-sparse/run_mvp.py \

echo "Done external_only: $(date)"

echo ""
echo "===== PHASE 2 COMPLETE ====="
echo "End: $(date)"
